name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-dce-sample
description: A reference dynamic core extension: one shared counter, so two consumers can prove they hold the same instance

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-dce-nettools
description: Network primitives shared by Kwirth extensions: TCP reachability and DNS resolution in the back end, and the icon and a shared latency chart in the front end. No binary is spawned

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-dce-three
description: Shared three.js 3D library for Kwirth extensions: consumers get the THREE namespace via getDce(), without each bundling its own copy

name: @kwirthmagnify/kwirth-dce-xyflow
description: Shared React Flow (@xyflow/react) and ELK (elkjs) graph libraries for Kwirth extensions: consumers get both via getDce(), without each bundling its own copy
